verdict.rationale: WooCommerce exposes a REST API (CRUD via JSON), a CLI (WC-CLI) for command-line store management, and a native MCP server for AI assistants — all of which could be scripted to perform bulk operations across many items — but no evidence explicitly documents batch/bulk endpoints or bulk-processing workflows for AI-native automation. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoint documentation, evidence of MCP or CLI actually performing multi-item bulk actions, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk operation performance at scale.
